title: Coaching ladder reflection & 90-day growth blueprint
content:
Purpose (one line):
Quick internal playbook for the next 90 days — capture micro-evidence, frame asks for my manager, and test two development experiments (coaching & stretch assignment).

Quick context:
- Role: individual contributor, people ops (growth & performance).
- Current signal: consistent high collaboration + a few delivery gaps on cross-functional deadlines (Q3 OKR follow-up).
- Stretch goal: move from ‘trusted operator’ to ‘strategic partner’ with measurable influence on two product-area roadmap decisions by end of Q2.

Top-level goals (90 days):
1) Influence: Get invited to at least 2 roadmap syncs as a required contributor. Have at least one recommendation accepted and tracked in roadmap.
2) Coaching: Run 6 coaching sessions with engineers/product managers focused on performance calibration; iterate the coaching checklist each week.
3) Evidence bank: Build 12 micro-stories (one per week) that show impact — short, timestamped, outcomes + metrics.
4) Delivery reliability: Reduce missed cross-functional action items from 4/month to <=1/month via a lightweight follow-up cadence.

Micro-evidence format (one-liner template):
- date | stakeholder | problem | intervention | outcome (metric if possible)
Examples (fill in as they happen):
- 2026-01-14 | Payments PM (Sara) | PRD missed scalability section leading to infra rework | Ran 30-min triage, wrote a one-page checklist, aligned owners | Restarted upstream work; avoided 2 sprint delays

Manager prep — things I want to bring to next 1:1 (top 6):
- Signal review: share 3 micro-stories and ask for explicit feedback on narrative framing.
- Ask for exposure: Request being the named people-ops owner for the payments roadmap sync for the next quarter.
- Coaching request: 1:1 shadow — ask manager to join two coaching sessions and give live feedback.
- Career check: Where do they see me in 12 months? What skill gaps block that path?
- Resourcing: Ask for 0.1 FTE from contractor budget for admin follow-ups if the delivery reliability experiment is green.
- Feedback calibration: Ask for 3 examples where I over/under-indexed on stakeholder influence in the past 6 months.

Manager prep script (30–60s lines I can say):
- "I want to run a focused experiment over the next 90 days to shift from operational delivery to strategic influence. I'll track weekly micro-stories and will ask you to: 1) critique the narratives; 2) let me own one roadmap sync; and 3) shadow two coaching sessions. Is that viable?"

Coaching playbook (lightweight):
- 15-min pre-check (problem framing + desired outcome).
- 25–35 min coaching conversation with two concrete follow-ups.
- 5 min recap + 1 action item logged to calendar with owner.
- Capture micro-evidence after each session (template above).

Two small experiments (A/B test style):
A) "Follow-up scaffolding" — a shared tracker and a 48-hour follow-up protocol (I’ll own). Measure reduction in action-item latency. Success = >=50% reduction by week 6.
B) "Recommendation-first framing" — in roadmap asks, present two options with cost/benefit and one recommended path. Measure acceptance rate vs prior baseline (current ~10-15% accepted on first pass).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: manager bandwidth to let me own syncs. Mitigate: propose shadowing first + incremental ownership.
- Risk: evidence stories feel self-promotional. Mitigate: focus on stakeholder outcomes and metrics; include quotes from collaborators.

Priority weekly checklist (my personal ritual):
- Mon: pick one micro-story and draft initial sentence.
- Tue: run or prep a coaching session.
- Wed: follow-up tracker review + escalate blockers.
- Thu: refine micro-story + ask a peer for 1-line quote.
- Fri: 10-min manager update draft; log wins and one ask.

Quick scripts for difficult asks: 
- If manager pushes back on time: "If we can't create space now, can we commit to a small pilot (one sync) and revisit in 6 weeks?"
- If asks for proof of impact: "I'll surface three micro-stories with outcomes and a simple metric; if we don't see traction we'll pivot the approach."

Open questions to track:
- Which roadmap owner is most likely to accept a people-ops recommendation without product sponsorship? (note candidate: Payments, Platform infra)
- Is there a clean way to tag micro-stories to OKRs for later performance write-up?
- What’s the lowest-effort way to instrument action-item latency? (suggestion: small Google Sheet + Zapier reminder)

Archive tags for each micro-story (use these keywords when saving):
- "influence", "reliability", "coaching", "escalation-averted", "cost-saved"

End-of-doc reminders:
- Do a 6-week review with manager: show evidence, review the follow-up scaffold metric, decide whether to scale.
- If successful, propose a 0.2 FTE headcount ask for Q3 to embed the follow-up function in people ops.

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep stories short. Managers skim — front-load outcomes.
- Use calendar invites as evidence (attach notes).
- Ask for peer quotes early; they increase credibility.
- Don't try to show everything at once — focus on two clear wins.

Unresolved: my timeline for moving to a manager/lead role — is it 12 or 18 months? Need to clarify in next calibration convo.

Quick links I keep referencing:
- /confluence/manager-coaching-ladder (internal)
- HR-4231 (policy on stretch assignments)

-- end --
